checked_classes: Spec violations — acceptance criteria have corresponding source changes, OpenSpec delta, and source-bound evidence in the diff

Correctness — reviewed subscription deadline handling, per-event auth checks, Keto cache invalidation/fencing, JWKS age bounding, and runtime harness paths; no concrete defect provable from the packet
Regressions — public JWKS cache type break is explicitly recorded as a compatibility impact, and no other dependent behavior in the packet is shown broken
Security — no committed secrets, production auth bypass, sensitive logging, or tenant-isolation bypass is evident in the touched files
Constraint breaches — no adapter dependency direction violation, proto edit, unwrap/expect in library code, hardcoded secret, or file-size breach is present in the diff
Silent failure — authority transport failures and malformed Keto denial responses fail closed in the changed code paths shown
